accepted_research_conclusion: The strongest evidence-bound Host Reality Twin design is a three-tier escalation fabric: nspawn/namespaces as the default cheap userspace twin, QEMU/KVM only for separate-kernel/boot/device-model obligations, and exact physical TargetHostProfile-bound execution for final host-specific evidence. Tier A/B receipts remain simulated-host evidence and cannot mint physical target-host completion.
